# subtitlefixer.com

> Free subtitle tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded.

## Tools
- [Shift subtitles](https://subtitlefixer.com/shift-subtitles): move all SRT/VTT/ASS timings forward or back by milliseconds.
- [Fix subtitle encoding](https://subtitlefixer.com/fix-subtitle-encoding): repair garbled characters and convert subtitles to UTF-8.
- [SRT to VTT](https://subtitlefixer.com/srt-to-vtt): convert SubRip to WebVTT for HTML5 video.
- [VTT to SRT](https://subtitlefixer.com/vtt-to-srt): convert WebVTT to SubRip.
- [ASS to SRT](https://subtitlefixer.com/ass-to-srt): convert Advanced SubStation Alpha to SRT, stripping styles.
- [Fix subtitle drift](https://subtitlefixer.com/fix-subtitle-drift): retime SRT, VTT, and ASS from two cues, or scale between 23.976, 24, and 25 fps.
